properties.name: Trans-Siberian Railway
properties.description: The world's longest railway line. Crosses 8 time zones and passes Lake Baikal — the deepest lake on Earth.

properties.name: Venice Simplon-Orient-Express
properties.description: The most romantic train in the world, inspiration for Agatha Christie's novel. Restored vintage 1920s carriages with fine dining.

properties.name: Rocky Mountaineer
properties.description: Daylight-only journey through the Canadian Rockies with glass-domed carriages. Passes Pyramid Falls and Spiral Tunnels.

properties.name: California Zephyr
properties.description: Often called the most beautiful train ride in America. Crosses the Rockies and the Sierra Nevada with panoramic sightseer lounges.

properties.name: Glacier Express
properties.description: The world's slowest express train. Takes 8 hours to cross 291 Alpine bridges and tunnels, with panoramic windows and onboard dining.

properties.name: The Ghan
properties.description: Crosses Australia from south to north through the Red Centre. Named after Afghan cameleers who pioneered the Outback route.

properties.name: Qinghai-Tibet Railway
properties.description: The world's highest railway, peaking at 5,072m. Oxygen is pumped into carriages, and 960 km of track rests on permafrost.

properties.name: Flåm Railway
properties.description: Descends 863m in just 20km through 20 tunnels — one of the world's steepest standard-gauge railways. Passes the thundering Kjosfossen waterfall.

properties.name: Tazara Railway
properties.description: Built by China in the 1970s. Passes through Selous Game Reserve — giraffes and elephants are regularly spotted from the window.

properties.name: Reunification Express
properties.description: Runs the length of Vietnam's S-shaped coast. The dramatic Hai Van Pass section offers jungle and ocean views in equal measure.

properties.name: Shinkansen Tōkaidō
properties.description: The world's first high-speed rail line. Trains run at 285 km/h with average delays measured in seconds per year.

properties.name: Bernina Express
properties.description: A UNESCO World Heritage rail journey. Crosses the spiral Landwasser Viaduct and the Bernina Pass at 2,253m — without needing cogwheels.
